title: 7408 Quad 2-Input AND Gate Verification
description: Assemble a 7408 IC logic circuit and verify its electrical truth table using the Arduino.

steps.title: Insert 7408 Quad AND Gate IC
steps.instruction: Place the 14-pin 7408 IC straddling the central divider trough, Pin 1 at E10, with notch pointing left toward column 1.

hints.missing: Place the 14-pin 7408 IC across the center breadboard trough.
hints.wrong_position: Ensure the IC straddles the center divider with Pin 1 in hole E10.
hints.reversed: Orient the IC with the notch pointing left toward column 1.

steps.title: Wire IC Power (+5V) and Ground (GND)
steps.instruction: Connect Pin 14 (F10) to +rail with a red wire, and Pin 7 (E16) to -rail with a black wire.

hints.missing: Connect Pin 14 (F10) to +rail and Pin 7 (E16) to -rail.
hints.wrong_position: Power wire must connect hole F10 (Pin 14) directly to the +rail.

steps.title: Wire Input A (Arduino D2 to Pin 1)
steps.instruction: Connect Arduino Digital Pin 2 to 7408 Pin 1 (E10) with a yellow jumper wire.

hints.missing: Connect Arduino D2 to 7408 Pin 1 at hole E10.
hints.wrong_position: Input A jumper must seat in hole E10 (Pin 1).

steps.title: Wire Input B (Arduino D3 to Pin 2)
steps.instruction: Connect Arduino Digital Pin 3 to 7408 Pin 2 (E11) with a yellow jumper wire.

hints.missing: Connect Arduino D3 to 7408 Pin 2 at hole E11.
hints.wrong_position: Input B jumper must seat in hole E11 (Pin 2).

steps.title: Wire Output Y & Indicator (Pin 3 to Arduino D4 & LED)
steps.instruction: Connect 7408 Pin 3 (E12) to Arduino Digital Pin 4 and indicator LED anode.

hints.missing: Connect 7408 Pin 3 at hole E12 to Arduino D4.
hints.wrong_position: Output wire must seat in hole E12 (Pin 3).

steps.title: Verify AND Gate Truth Table
steps.instruction: Hands clear. Press TEST to execute electrical truth table verification over Arduino.

hints.missing: Ensure all pins and wires are firmly seated before electrical verification.
